english.note: Use this when stressing that something is obvious despite someone denying it or acting otherwise.

examples.english: You obviously said you wouldn't eat spicy food, so why did you order spicy chicken?
examples.traditional: 你明明話咗唔食辣，點解又叫辣雞？
